description: This file contains internal testing utilities for PyTorch's autograd registration, including a context manager to set autograd fallback mode and a function to check correct autograd registration for operators.

methods.name: set_autograd_fallback_mode
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily set the autograd fallback mode.

methods.name: autograd_registration_check
methods.description: Checks if autograd is registered correctly for a given operator, ensuring proper kernel registration for autograd support.
